summary: Completed frontend testing of 5 specific Moonshot features. 4 out of 5 features working correctly, 1 critical bug found in duplicate prevention.

critical_bugs.issue: Duplicate stock entries allowed when clicking same stock from category page
critical_bugs.description: When adding AAPL from search, then navigating to Technology category and clicking AAPL again, duplicate entries are created instead of being prevented

Feature 3: Calendar date picker in Compare mode (replaced dropdowns) - ✅ WORKING
Feature 4: Chart title shows just ticker name (not 'Historical Price - TICKER') - ✅ WORKING
Feature 5: Earnings Snapshot section with CapEx, FCF, Gross Margin, ROE, Target Price, Recommendation - ✅ WORKING
Access gate authentication with MOONSHOT code
Financials section with earnings metrics display
action_item_for_main_agent: Fix duplicate stock prevention bug in Feature 1. The useEffect logic for handling URL params from category pages is not properly preventing duplicates when the same stock is clicked from different sources (search vs category page).
